data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and fund pilot
data.body:
Hi,

PMC FIG Opportunities LLC's most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in BMRC and FCBM.

On October 16, 2026, BMRC disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1403475/000140347526000041/bmrc-20261016.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
